items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: And I played occasionally make-up bands, Kid Howard, and Chic, and different fellas. A band would have just gone down for that day, Kid Howard band, or Kid Chic.

ctx.x: I just wondered who some of the ones were that didn't make it later.
Oh, well they had a lot of guys. I mean it, let me see. Definitely not. Kid Howard, he was a fella I went a while, he made it. Alright. Rika, yep he made it.
Well what about your father in law, Joe H. Foer, did he play with many bands?
